summary: Executed backend pytest and frontend Playwright validation focused on OpenAI default provider behavior, 402 quota handling for KAK/OCR, model picker visibility, and API key secrecy.

critical.issue: OPTIONS preflight from frontend origin returned 400 'Disallowed CORS origin' while credentials headers are enabled; this can break cross-origin credentialed auth in strict browser scenarios.

ui_bugs.issue: No OCR model picker present for PIC flow (count=0), so frontend requirement 'OCR PIC default OpenAI' cannot be validated from active PIC workspace.

integration_issues.issue: React runtime console warning about duplicate keys ('Nikah Masal') indicates non-unique key usage in rendered list items.

action_items: Fix CORS origin matching for credentialed auth preflight so frontend origin receives non-400 preflight response with explicit allow-origin.
Wire/restore PIC OCR flow in active workspace (or expose OCR model picker in intended PIC screen) so OpenAI default for OCR PIC is testable and usable.
Resolve duplicate React key warning in project list rendering to prevent unstable UI reconciliation.
critical_code_review_comments: Sensitive API secrets are committed in backend/.env (OPENAI_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY, EMERGENT_LLM_KEY) — rotate keys immediately and remove plaintext secrets from repository history.
server.py remains a very large monolith (>1400 LOC visible), increasing regression risk for auth/AI routing changes; split into smaller modules.
AI error mapping for OpenAI quota is functioning correctly (402 with clear billing guidance) for /api/ai/kak and /api/ai/ocr when provider omitted.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing seeded PIC and Relawan accounts from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend validations confirm requested AI defaults for KAK/OCR: no provider -> OpenAI models and clear HTTP 402 on no credits. Frontend confirms OpenAI default + Gemini visibility for Ide, RAB, KAK, Laporan, and Relawan OCR. PIC OCR UI path is missing in current active workspace (keuangan tab has no ModelPicker).
rca of the issue: RCA-1 (CORS): preflight returns 'Disallowed CORS origin' despite same preview domain usage, suggesting origin list parsing/mismatch at backend runtime or ingress-origin discrepancy; reproduce with OPTIONS /api/auth/login including Origin + Access-Control-Request-* headers. RCA-2 (PIC OCR): OCR UI component exists (RealisasiTab.jsx) but is not mounted in current PIC workspace route; therefore OCR PIC default requirement cannot be fulfilled from reachable PIC flow.
